questions.text: In order to insure compliance with the law, Miguel routinely overshoots the weight of his tortillas by 0.5 gram. He just received a report that told him that he could be losing as much as $100,000 per year using this practice. If the ideal thickness of the tortilla is 0.04 inches, what thickness of tortillas will be guaranteed?
